files.freesoundName: Waterfall Saas-Fee Gletschersee South Small Big 100711.wav
files.description: Saas-Fee (1800 meters above sea level, Switzerland) is surrounded by a number of high mountains. A considerable part of those mountains is covered in ice and snow. During summer, the glaciers melt and produce a massive amount of melt water that runs through various stages before running into the Fee
files.author: LG
